bounded_checks.subject: Bibliography and claim fidelity for items 35-38
evidence: Urdinez et al. examine foreign direct investment, bank loans, and international trade; Kastner and Pearson review intended and unintended influence mechanisms, firms, economic ties, aid, sanctions, and economic statecraft. The broadened item 35-36 sentence is source-consistent as a collective citation cluster.

Struver's publisher metadata is Foreign Policy Analysis 12(2), 170-191, DOI 10.1111/fpa.12050. The accessible working-paper text states that significant trade dependence may be a consequence of foreign-policy similarity and that good political understanding is conducive to economic exchange, while disclaiming causal identification. Retaining the reverse-causality citation is source-faithful; the Refine characterization was not inherited.

MacDonald and Parent is World Politics 73(2), 358-391, DOI 10.1017/S0043887120000301. Its publisher abstract reviews tensions between standing and membership; it does not support the attributed claim that status is merely an attribute rather than a relation. Removing only this citation from the undifferentiated cluster is conservative and introduces no false claim, but the rejected source summary is not endorsed.

The local entries match title, authors, year, journal, volume, issue, and pages. The active Struver entry omits its DOI, and the now-unused MacDonald-Parent record labels Project MUSE as publisher; neither changes the candidate's source claim or rendered cited-reference set in this selected correction.

bounded_checks.subject: Item 25 domain_note fidelity, author-facing independence, and proposal boundary
evidence: The note accurately distinguishes the current country-plus-resolution fixed effects and Brazil-by-domain interaction from a possible country-by-domain extension, and it preserves the conditional nature of the concern.

Existing sensitivity outputs reproduce the note: current corrected coefficient -0.2223334018; country-domain coefficient -0.2257312276; change -0.0033978258, or 1.528257 percent of the current absolute coefficient. The archived Frisch-Waugh-Lovell discrepancy is 1.57827390046e-10; the adversarial synthetic donor-domain coefficient is 0.0317919 under the current formula and zero with country-domain effects.

The note separates observed evidence, a synthetic illustration, causal limits, and future options. Proposed targets are explicitly non-existent, unauthorized, and unexecuted; there is no manuscript replacement.
The six-page item25 PDF was visually inspected. Its table and notes are legible without overlap or clipping; wrapped paths and hashes are awkward but manageable and not a substantive layout defect.

bounded_checks.subject: Cross-cutting source and result coherence for the remaining changed selected items
evidence: Item 6's 2004-2008 exposure means, 2008-2009 activation, standardization, Pink Sheet construction, and absorbed lower-order terms match scripts/diagnostics/audit_brazil_sdid_predetermined_commodity_controls.R:190-257,293-326 and audit_brazil_sdid_commodity_no_covariates.R:97-151.

Item 11's stored timing_placebos.csv confirms nominal onsets 2003, 2004, 2005, 2009, and 2012; end years 2008, 2008, 2008, 2015, and 2016; and point estimates -0.0637, -0.1087, -0.0992, -0.2728, and -0.1000. The candidate accurately calls these separately refitted, different-window diagnostics rather than common-estimand tests.

Item 18's existing main summary records 20,000 placebo-SE replications with seed 20260520, while the exhaustive directional and absolute ranks use 96 assignments. The candidate separates these objects and the subsequent normal approximation.

Items 20 and 32 define full positive unit and time weights consistently with the stated SDiD objectives and correct the former reversal of the time-weight target. No estimator equation or result changes.
Item 21's vote coding, observed-vote filter, China-US divergence rule, signed distance outcome, and country-plus-resolution fixed effects match scripts/functions.R:6555-6561,6634-6675,6908-6918.

Item 22 matches stored IFE outputs: both UNGA-DM fixed-factor fits are negative with intervals spanning zero; within either outcome the two-factor point estimate is more negative; the paired comparisons are scale-dependent and do not test equivalence or identify an additive outcome-source component.

Item 27 matches the existing annual series: comparing 2005-2008 with 2009-2012, China's mean shifts about -0.065 on the Bailey scale and Brazil's about -0.325, while annual volatility remains visible. The candidate uses descriptive rather than variance-attribution language.

Item 31's stored-input check covers 1,920 country-years, finds no country power above U.S. power and zero residual from us_power_gap = us_power - gpi. The candidate preserves the no-covariate preferred specification and does not claim separate identification from a nonzero nuisance coefficient. Full methodological promotion remains a separate gate.

bounded_checks.subject: Candidate mechanics, target-first discipline, references, and render boundary
evidence: All 52 R chunks parse without evaluation; labels are nonempty and unique. All 47 literal figure/table reference occurrences resolve to 36 unique chunk labels.
The multiset of 144 inline R expressions is identical to the baseline. Added lines contain no tar_read, readRDS, model fitting, assignment, or new analytical computation.
The diff has no whitespace errors, and no added line uses spell or treatment spell in author-facing prose.

No candidate PDF was present and the integrator explicitly did not render. Candidate table-note layout therefore was not visually certified in this review; only the available item25 PDF was visually checked. This conditional render limit is not a source or scope defect.

reasons: No confirmed, partial, or unresolved defect was found in the assigned documentation, bibliography, fidelity, selected-scope, numerical-label, or domain-note checks of the final candidate.
All candidate changes were localized to selected items and respected orchestrator decisions, including the proposal-only target boundary for item 4 and no manuscript changes for items 15, 25, and 37.

This verdict is bounded: it is not a blanket scientific proof, does not replace the separate full abstract numeric gate or independent methodological review, and does not certify candidate PDF layout because no candidate render exists.
